status: predeclared_before_any_new_outcomes; execute only after source qualification accepted
question: 每年6月底选择持有一年，排除报告资产增长较快且毛利资产比较低的股票，能否改善相对只看扩张、毛利、简单合分的选择
scope: independent historical A-share stock selection; not ETF, not original LEI, no real account

observations.entry: July first market trading day close after decision
observations.exit: next July first market trading day close
observations.unmatured: 2025 kept coverage only; never shorten outcome or substitute future cutoff

old_price_semantics: saved BaoStock adjustflag2 daily quotes; input/source adjudication retained; no new requests; dividends/corporate action cash not reconciled. annual outcome must read underlying raw quotes not multiply monthly selections.
eligibility: source qualification terminal plus current signal-day actual trading/known ST0, old eligible June momentum and price eligibility projection. No future availability filter. All planned600 and unknown records preserved; future entry/exit failures retain original weight.

groups.industry: inherited leading CSRC2 digit, annual snapshot asknown; J excluded inherited
groups.quadrants: per year industry unweighted median growth and gp; strict > median high, < median low, equals ties; ties stay in selection except strictHG/LP; fourcell effect only industries with all4 nonempty; report missing/tie support
groups.interaction: within high growth highGP-lowGP minus within low growth highGP-lowGP; industry aggregation n_sector/supportedN; all4 same supported sectors
groups.primary_policy: Conditional exclude only growth>medianG AND GP<medianGP; retain all others, k per sector; all methods same industry weights n/N and fully invest

methods.C: conditional exclusion, equal initial sector allocation among retained

groups.ties: rank score ties averaged; cutoff weight split among tied names so selected mass k, no code tiebreak. Record actual count/HHI. C can k=n and equals P; do not infer no-action protection.

annual_valuation.weights: fixed initial stock units from initial weights/entry price, mark weights drift with price, no intra-year sale/rebalance/reallocation
annual_valuation.months: month-end closes from July through next June plus exact final exit; mark all original stocks including ST/suspension; stock raw quote missing remains missing, never use future to drop or renormalize
unknown_scenarios: each unknown valuation at 0% change from original entry
each unknown valuation at -100% from original entry
annual_valuation.label: two sensitivity scenarios not real recovery bounds; show observed weight/unknown weight/endpoint halt weights
annual_valuation.risk: Only first12 segments from July entry to next June month-end enter same P-up/down month comparison; first segment slightly short. Final short segment to next July first close is only annual endpoint/drawdown. This retrospective classification is not a switching signal.
annual_valuation.counterexamples: all ten years, first5 vs last5, leave-one-year-out paired means, excluded stocks annual gains/losses and contribution, top contributors; no posthoc rule change
annual_valuation.fees: Gross terminal wealth V transforms to V*(1-s)/(1+b) for b=s=0.001 and0.003. Fully purchasable/liquidatable assumption, no guarantee conservative, no realized net-account claim, no cross-year netting.
annual_valuation.concentration: stock count, max initial weight, sum squared weights, n_selected, k, target membership replacement across years; no real human maintenance saving
annual_valuation.observability: Each segment records original missing weight and both endpoint observability. Separate fully_observed from scenario_involved conditional estimates. Prior NAV zero gives null percent change. Marked drawdowns identify imputation; no imputed decline is evidence of actual protection. Missing or untradable entry retains original weight with no invented units in all later unknown scenarios; later suspension is a mark, not executable liquidation.

uncertainty.unit: annual cohorts, not stock rows independent
uncertainty.paired_95_interval: annual shared-year resampling with block length2,10000 draws,seed20261019; only10 years, coarse exploratory interval not proof
uncertainty.no_useful_effect_threshold: not pre-agreed; do not claim ruling out economically meaningful improvement

denominator_identity: GP/Acurrent*(1+G)=GP/Aprior; combined signals may mechanically overlap. A real conditional difference is not proof of two independent mechanisms or causal investment quality.
followups: max3 purposeful only if specific ambiguity changes conclusion; first preserve all primary results; do not fill quota or tune partitions
prohibited: repeat P1/P2 or using per_stock_month chain as annual wealth
technical_preflight: reuse lowfreq_research_control.check before any outcome read; raw label files must be bound; source-only selector score=G financial_score=GP momentum=M, exact allowed columns. Contract scientific identity/history and budget bound by root after qualification.

source_requests.supports: annual asset change and June formation only; US universe not local performance
French OP subtracts cost interest SG&A and divides equity, distinct from local gross_profit/assets; not claiming replication

amendment.reason: independent scientific review: partial tail, observed vs imputed marks, exact fee convention, actual registry IDs
